canDoYue: 你識喺轉機前睇申報表、問幾早去入境處，同大袋喺邊個行李轉盤托運。
canDoEn: Ask about a declaration, a layover, immigration, and the carousel.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you please check my declaration before the layover and tell me which belt?
dialogue.glossYue: 轉機停留之前可唔可以睇吓我張申報表，話我知邊條帶？
dialogue.say: Could you please check my declaration before the layover and tell me which belt?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Your declaration is fine, and the layover belt is number three on the left side.
dialogue.glossYue: 你張申報表冇問題，轉機停留嗰條帶係左邊三號。
dialogue.say: Your declaration is fine, and the layover belt is number three on the left side.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If the layover leaves at two, how early should I reach immigration with one bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果轉機停留兩點走，我應該幾早帶住一個袋去入境處？
dialogue.say: If the layover leaves at two, how early should I reach immigration with one bag?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Please reach immigration by one o'clock, because your layover at two needs extra time.
dialogue.glossYue: 請一點前去入境處，因為你兩點嘅轉機停留要多啲時間。
dialogue.say: Please reach immigration by one o'clock, because your layover at two needs extra time.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Where should I take this heavy bag if immigration sits past the carousel doors?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果入境處喺傳送帶嗰度門後面，我應該將呢件重行李拿到邊？
dialogue.say: Where should I take this heavy bag if immigration sits past the carousel doors?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Please take that heavy bag over to the carousel, and immigration sits past those doors.
dialogue.glossYue: 請將嗰件重行李拿到傳送帶，入境處就喺嗰度門後面。
dialogue.say: Please take that heavy bag over to the carousel, and immigration sits past those doors.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I keep one small bag and check the big bag at the far carousel?
dialogue.glossYue: 我可唔可以帶住一個細袋，大袋喺遠嘅傳送帶托運？
dialogue.say: Can I keep one small bag and check the big bag at the far carousel?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: You can keep the small case and check the big one at that far carousel.
dialogue.glossYue: 你可以帶住個細箱，大件喺遠嘅傳送帶托運。
dialogue.say: You can keep the small case and check the big one at that far carousel.
